instruction: Add Yumi Asai to contact with mobile number 96981 under the group "Work". If the group does not exist, then create it.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to value of phone of first person of group "Work" whose name is "Yumi Asai"' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "96981" && echo "True" || echo "False"
osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to value of phone of first person whose name is "Yumi Asai"' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "96981" && echo "True" || echo "False"
